mission: Build image hygiene for the three Railway Python services (CEO-approved plan 2026-11-21 22:07 MYT, content-pipeline ops/decisions.md L606; owner t589u L605; own PR per owner t586u L603 and CEO L604): deploy/railway/api.Dockerfile, beat.Dockerfile and worker.Dockerfile move from the floating python:3.12-slim tag to the same multi-arch index digest sha256:5e2bdb1b0d542d5039cffb8181c65930093949194a65c365dfb1b0fe13a4fa5b (read from Docker Hub 2026-11-23 14:35 MYT), and upgrade the base image's bundled pip to 26.2.2 before the first dependency install. No requirements, application code, collector input, services/api/Dockerfile or services/worker/Dockerfile change. DATA lane (build supply chain, owner rule t397u). Draft: the owner marks it ready.

impacts.reason: FROM python:3.12-slim becomes FROM python:3.12-slim@sha256:5e2bdb1b0d542d5039cffb8181c65930093949194a65c365dfb1b0fe13a4fa5b in all three, and RUN python -m pip install --no-cache-dir "pip==26.2.2" is added before the first pip install -r. The API, worker and beat rebuild through their Railway GitHub triggers on the merge commit. Collector runtime inputs unchanged (changed_runtime_inputs ab56bc7a..HEAD: snkrdunk [], yuyutei []).

resources: staging api, worker and beat services (Railway GitHub-triggered builds)
routes: No route change. No source request.
dependencies: staging at ab56bc7a or later (#305 delivered)
impact.deployment_impact: API, worker and beat images rebuild on the merge commit from the pinned base with pip 26.2.2; installed application dependencies resolve from the same requirements files as today. No collector release (collector runtime inputs unchanged). No schema change. verify_staging_delivery checks the API only; worker and beat deployment status is read back separately after merge.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file (back to the floating tag and the base image's pip); Railway redeploys api, worker and beat from the revert merge.
recovery.trigger: An api, worker or beat build or deploy failure after merge, a failing delivery verify, or a crash loop in worker or beat.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.
